$Comment: Santa's Nice List: the name, picture and payouts of the game's reputation group of the same id
(NPC/Reputation/Groups/Christmas_Nice_List.json), which keeps each player's number. Players read the
name from reputation.christmas_nice_list.name; never rename the id, since every player's favor is
filed under it.
Ranks renames the library's ranks for Santa alone; a rank left out keeps the library's name, and a
lock on one of these ranks reads the name written here. The ids stay the library's (Honored is the
rank Santa calls Nice). Order places the list on the Reputation page after Martha's Favor.
Favor comes from Santa's daily word, from any Reputation reward a Christmas quest, job or the Yeti's
fight pays, from
each Christmas Present given to another player (Item/Interactions/Christmas/Christmas_Present_Give.json)
and each carol sung (DialogueExtensions/SeasonsOfOrbis/Christmas_Carol.json), and
from Kills: Amount favor for each creature put down whose role is in one of the listed NPC groups,
here Christmas_Present_Thieves (NPC/Groups), the Trorks in Santa hats, and Christmas_Game_Trorks,
the game's own grown Trorks, for less and only while Christmas runs (the row's Season), since they
live in the world all year. The Christmas Set and the Christmas Cake raise every gain of this favor
by a percent, through the stat TrackGain_Christmas_Nice_List (Entity/Stats), which the library
finds by this file's id; gear that raises the library's shared CategoryGain_Reputation still does too.
With no Cap, favor keeps climbing past Exalted (Santa's Favorite), and each time earned favor passes
another multiple of Every above Exalted's floor, Beyond's Rewards wait for the player to collect them
on the Reputation page: here the loot table Christmas_Santas_Sack. Earn lists the ways to earn favor,
one lang key a line, for the How to earn block on the Reputation page.
The ranks open things up at the Christmas stalls: Friendly (On the List) the Christmas Gloves and the
Christmas Wand, Honored (Nice) the Hot Cocoa recipe and the Christmas Hat, Revered (Very Nice) the
Christmas Cake recipe, the Christmas Trousers and the Santa Suit, and Exalted (Santa's Favorite) the
Christmas Coat.
